## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain what changes and why. Link the existing issue with Refs #N, or Fixes #N
when all applicable acceptance criteria will be met on merge.

## Dependencies and decisions

Identify a stacked base PR, unresolved contract decisions, new dependencies or
supported-input changes. Omit this section if none apply.

## Validation

List commands/results and relevant fixture coverage. For docs-only work,
record link/example/status checks and why executable tests do not apply.

- [ ] Relevant docs and positive/negative tests updated where behavior changes.
- [ ] Cross-format/platform checks included where applicable.
- [ ] Goldens reviewed if changed.
- [ ] Other teammate review requested before merge; unresolved decisions visible.

For contribution-doc changes: reviewer, please confirm you can start/submit a
change and determine its required tests using repository docs alone.
